title: 描眉画目：以骨相为基础，以眉形修饰五官
title_en: Miaomeihuamu: brow design grounded in bone structure and facial harmony
intro: 描眉画目·定制美学是一家位于上海浦东前滩南侧（三林地区）的私人定制纹绣工作室，主打仪器野生眉私人定制，全部设计与操作由乐乐老师本人一对一完成。
intro_en: Miaomeihuamu · Bespoke Aesthetics is a private permanent makeup studio in Sanlin, Pudong, Shanghai (south of Qiantan), specialising in bespoke instrument hair-stroke brows designed and performed one-to-one by Lele.

sections.title: 骨相修饰逻辑：让眉眼与颧骨顺畅衔接，不套流水线眉形
sections.title_en: Bone-structure logic: coordinating brows, eyes and cheekbones
sections.description: 很多人纹眉踩坑，是因为只盯着“当下流行什么弯度”或强行照搬别人的平眉、欧挑眉，却忽略了自己眉眶骨高不高、太阳穴宽不宽、颧骨突不突出。乐乐老师做设计时会从整张脸的立体折叠度出发：通过微调眉头起落、眉峰转折位和眉尾收束方向，在视觉上柔化颧骨转折、协调眉眼比例，让面部轮廓看起来更舒展流畅，而不是硬生生改变实际骨骼。
sections.description_en: Many disappointing brows come from copying trending curves while ignoring brow-bone projection, temple width and cheekbone prominence. Lele designs from facial plane folding: fine-tuning the brow start, peak angle and tail taper so brows visually soften cheekbone transitions and balance eye spacing without forcing rigid geometry.

sections.title: 全线真实项目：以仪器野生眉为主打，覆盖眼唇与发际线
sections.title_en: Full service scope: led by instrument brows, covering eyes, lips and hairline
sections.description: 品牌以画派仪器野生眉（单仪器）和画派双仪器初绒野生眉为核心主打，同时提供手工野生眉、丝雾眉、绒雾眉满足不同毛发基础与妆感需求；配套的五官微调项目包括美瞳线（可按黑/棕与眼型定制粗细）、扩唇（唇形调整）、改乌唇（深唇底层转色）、纹发际线以及纹人中窝光影修饰。每项均有明确适用边界，不在合适之外乱接。
sections.description_en: Our core focus is bespoke Huapai single- and dual-instrument hair-stroke brows, alongside manual, silk-shaded and velvet-shaded brows. Complementary services include lash-line enhancement, lip-contour refinement, dark-lip colour correction, hairline pigmentation and philtrum shading—each assessed individually for suitability.

sections.title: 坚持先看方案再决定：免费设计、不做升单、透明沟通
sections.title_en: See the design first: free consultation, zero upselling and transparent terms
sections.description: 工作室2024年8月正式营业，乐乐老师2016年入行至今全程亲自接待、亲自设计、亲自操作，没有顾问推销或中途换手。到店设计免费约30–45分钟，看过画出来的效果觉得适合再决定做不做；门店不做升单，项目前讲清价格与方案（具体定价以大众点评当期门店信息为准），操作使用一次性耗材，所有项目享一年内免费补色。
sections.description_en: Opened in August 2024 by Lele (practising since 2016), the studio handles every consultation and treatment personally with single-use tools and no sales consultants. The 30–45 minute design session is free with no upselling, prices follow our current Dianping listing, and all services include free touch-ups within one year.

sections.title: 实体门店方位与预约方式
sections.title_en: Single Pudong location and booking details
sections.description: 门店只有浦东长清路这一家（上海市浦东新区三林长清路1200弄39号1613室，前滩南侧，6号线灵岩南路站2号口往西步行约300米），周一至周日10:00–20:00预约接待。可通过微信 MiaoMeiHuaMu 或致电 19282182068 预约面诊时间。
sections.description_en: We operate a single private studio at Room 1613, No. 39, Lane 1200 Changqing Road, Sanlin, Pudong, Shanghai (south of Qiantan, ~300 m west of Metro Line 6 Lingyan South Road Exit 2), open daily 10:00–20:00 by appointment via WeChat MiaoMeiHuaMu or +86 192 8218 2068.
